/**
 * Returns the Blit test image as SDL_Surface.
 */

@B g9j 8253
SDL_Surface *SDLTest_ImageBlit(void)
{
    SDL_Surface *surface = SDL_CreateSurfaceFrom(
        SDLTest_imageBlit.width,
        SDLTest_imageBlit.height,
        SDL_PIXELFORMAT_RGB24,
        (void *)SDLTest_imageBlit.pixel_data,
        SDLTest_imageBlit.width * SDLTest_imageBlit.bytes_per_pixel);
    return surface;
}

/**
 * Returns the BlitTiled test image as SDL_Surface.
 */

@B g9o 8200
SDL_Surface *SDLTest_ImageBlitTiled(void)
{
    SDL_Surface *surface = SDL_CreateSurfaceFrom(
        SDLTest_imageBlitTiled.width,
        SDLTest_imageBlitTiled.height,
        SDL_PIXELFORMAT_RGB24,
        (void *)SDLTest_imageBlitTiled.pixel_data,
        SDLTest_imageBlitTiled.width * SDLTest_imageBlitTiled.bytes_per_pixel);
    return surface;
}

/**
 * \brief Returns the clamped rendering sprite test image as an SDL_Surface.
 */
SDL_Surface *SDLTest_ImageClampedSprite(void)
{
    SDL_Surface *surface = SDL_CreateSurfaceFrom(
            SDLTest_imageClampedSprite.width,
            SDLTest_imageClampedSprite.height,
            SDL_PIXELFORMAT_RGB24,
            (void *)SDLTest_imageClampedSprite.pixel_data,
            SDLTest_imageClampedSprite.width * SDLTest_imageClampedSprite.bytes_per_pixel);
    return surface;
}

/**
 * Returns the Face test image as SDL_Surface.
 */

@B ga0 1588
SDL_Surface *SDLTest_ImageFace(void)
{
    SDL_Surface *surface = SDL_CreateSurfaceFrom(
        SDLTest_imageFace.width,
        SDLTest_imageFace.height,
        SDL_PIXELFORMAT_RGBA32,
        (void *)SDLTest_imageFace.pixel_data,
        SDLTest_imageFace.width * SDLTest_imageFace.bytes_per_pixel);
    return surface;
}

/**
 * Returns the Primitives test image as SDL_Surface.
 */

@B ga8 8234
SDL_Surface *SDLTest_ImagePrimitives(void)
{
    SDL_Surface *surface = SDL_CreateSurfaceFrom(
        SDLTest_imagePrimitives.width,
        SDLTest_imagePrimitives.height,
        SDL_PIXELFORMAT_RGB24,
        (void *)SDLTest_imagePrimitives.pixel_data,
        SDLTest_imagePrimitives.width * SDLTest_imagePrimitives.bytes_per_pixel);
    return surface;
}

/**
 * \brief Returns the blending rendering background test image as an SDL_Surface.
 */

@B gac 6042
SDL_Surface *SDLTest_ImageBlendingBackground(void)
{
    SDL_Surface *surface = SDL_CreateSurfaceFrom(
            SDLTest_imageRainbowBackground.width,
            SDLTest_imageRainbowBackground.height,
            SDL_PIXELFORMAT_BGRA32,
            (void *)SDLTest_imageRainbowBackground.pixel_data,
            SDLTest_imageRainbowBackground.width * SDLTest_imageRainbowBackground.bytes_per_pixel);
    return surface;
}

/**
 * \brief Returns the blending rendering sprite test image as an SDL_Surface.
 */

@B gah 8202
SDL_Surface *SDLTest_ImageBlendingSprite(void)
{
    SDL_Surface *surface = SDL_CreateSurfaceFrom(
            SDLTest_imageTransparentSprite.width,
            SDLTest_imageTransparentSprite.height,
            SDL_PIXELFORMAT_BGRA32,
            (void *)SDLTest_imageTransparentSprite.pixel_data,
            SDLTest_imageTransparentSprite.width * SDLTest_imageTransparentSprite.bytes_per_pixel);
